/// A view model property that notifies listeners when its value changes.
/// Each kind of property is a subclass with a typed `value`.
export class Property {
    /// Registers a listener that is called whenever the property's value
    /// changes. Listening stops when the host disposes the script instance
    /// that added it.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// function onHealthChanged(): void {
    ///     console.log("health changed");
    /// }
    ///
    /// let health = vm.getNumber("health");
    /// if (health != null) {
    ///     health.addListener(onHealthChanged);
    ///     health.value = 50; // Notifies onHealthChanged
    /// }
    /// ```
    addListener(listener: () => void): void;

    /// Registers a listener that receives `context` each time it is called,
    /// and keeps `context` alive while registered. Remove it with
    /// `removeListenerWith`.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// export class Cannon extends Node {
    ///     shots: i32 = 0;
    ///
    ///     override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///         let vm = context.viewModel();
    ///         if (vm != null) {
    ///             let fire = vm.getTrigger("fire");
    ///             if (fire != null) {
    ///                 fire.addListenerWith(this, (self: Cannon): void => {
    ///                     self.shots++;
    ///                 });
    ///             }
    ///         }
    ///         return true;
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    addListenerWith<K>(context: K, listener: (context: K) => void): void;

    /// Removes every registration of a listener added with `addListener`,
    /// matched by function.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// health.removeListener(onHealthChanged);
    /// ```
    removeListener(listener: () => void): void;

    /// Removes every registration of a listener added with `addListenerWith`
    /// with this same `context` and `listener`. Other contexts registered
    /// with the same function keep listening.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// export class Cannon extends Node {
    ///     fire: PropertyTrigger? = null;
    ///     shots: i32 = 0;
    ///
    ///     static onFire(self: Cannon): void {
    ///         self.shots++;
    ///     }
    ///
    ///     override init(context: Context): bool {
    ///         let vm = context.viewModel();
    ///         if (vm != null) {
    ///             let fire = vm.getTrigger("fire");
    ///             if (fire != null) {
    ///                 fire.addListenerWith(this, Cannon.onFire);
    ///                 this.fire = fire;
    ///             }
    ///         }
    ///         return true;
    ///     }
    ///
    ///     stopListening(): void {
    ///         let fire = this.fire;
    ///         if (fire != null) {
    ///             fire.removeListenerWith(this, Cannon.onFire);
    ///         }
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    removeListenerWith<K>(context: K, listener: (context: K) => void): void;

    /// Removes every registration of a listener added with `addListenerWith`,
    /// whatever context it was added with, the way Luau's removeListener
    /// matches by function alone.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// fire.removeListenerWithAnyContext(Cannon.onFire);
    /// ```
    removeListenerWithAnyContext<K>(listener: (context: K) => void): void;

    /// Drops every listener and releases the property now instead of when it
    /// is collected. It reads nothing afterwards.
    release(): void;
}

/// A number property of a view model.
export class PropertyNumber extends Property {
    /// The current value. You can both read and assign it.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let health = vm.getNumber("health");
    /// if (health != null) {
    ///     console.log(health.value.toString());
    ///     health.value = 100;
    /// }
    /// ```
    get value(): f64;
    set value(v: f64);
}

/// A trigger property of a view model. Unlike other properties it stores no
/// value: `fire` notifies its listeners.
export class PropertyTrigger extends Property {
    /// Fires the trigger and notifies its listeners.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let cannon = vm.getTrigger("cannon");
    /// if (cannon != null) {
    ///     cannon.addListener((): void => {
    ///         console.log("cannon fired!");
    ///     });
    ///     cannon.fire();
    /// }
    /// ```
    fire(): void;
}

}

/// A mutable list of `ViewModel` items.
///
/// Use it to manage repeating data from scripts, such as menu items,
/// inventory entries or dynamic rows. A list supports:
/// - Reading the item count with `length`
/// - Indexed access counting from 0 (`list[0]`, `list[1]`, ...)
/// - Changes with `push`, `insert`, `swap`, `pop`, `shift`, `clear` and
///   the `remove` methods
/// - Change notifications with `addListener` and `removeListener`
export class PropertyList extends Property {
    /// The current number of items in the list.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// if (menu.length >= 2) {
    ///     menu.swap(0, 1);
    /// }
    /// ```
    get length(): i32;

    /// The item at `index`, counting from 0. An index out of range gives an
    /// empty view model whose property lookups return null, so check `length`
    /// first.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let item = menu[0];
    /// let label = item.getString("label");
    /// if (label != null) {
    ///     label.value = "Play";
    /// }
    /// ```
    operator[](index: i32): ViewModel;

    /// The item at `index`, counting from 0. The same as `list[index]`.
    get(index: i32): ViewModel;

    /// Adds a view model to the end of the list.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let button = ViewModel.create("Button");
    /// let label = button.getString("label");
    /// if (label != null) {
    ///     label.value = "Play";
    /// }
    /// menu.push(button);
    /// ```
    push(vm: ViewModel): void;

    /// Removes and returns the last view model in the list, or null when the
    /// list is empty.
    pop(): ViewModel?;

    /// Removes and returns the first view model in the list, or null when
    /// the list is empty.
    shift(): ViewModel?;

    /// Removes all view models from the list.
    clear(): void;

    /// Swaps the positions of the view models at `index1` and `index2`,
    /// counting from 0.
    swap(index1: i32, index2: i32): void;

    /// Inserts a view model at `index`, counting from 0.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// menu.insert(ViewModel.create("Button"), 0);
    /// ```
    insert(vm: ViewModel, index: i32): void;

    /// Removes the first entry that references the given view model.
    remove(vm: ViewModel): void;

    /// Removes the view model at `index`, counting from 0.
    removeAt(index: i32): void;

    /// Removes every entry that references the given view model.
    removeAllOf(vm: ViewModel): void;
}

/// A view model instance: named properties used for data binding between
/// your script and a Rive file.
///
/// Extend it with a class named after a view model in the file to declare a
/// view model input, or to name the view model an `Artboard` input binds.
/// The class needs a constructor that takes the handle, since constructors
/// are not inherited.
///
/// ```as
/// export class Character extends ViewModel {
///     constructor(handle: u32) {
///         super(handle);
///     }
/// }
///
/// export class Scene extends Node {
///     @input settings: Character? = null;
///     @input character: Artboard<Character>? = null;
///
///     override init(context: Context): bool {
///         let settings = this.settings;
///         if (settings != null) {
///             let health = settings.getNumber("health");
///         }
///         return true;
///     }
/// }
/// ```
export class ViewModel {
    /// Creates a new instance of the file's view model called `name`, copied
    /// from its instance called `instanceName` when given. When the file has
    /// no such view model the result has no properties; check with `exists`.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let button = ViewModel.create("Button");
    /// let label = button.getString("label");
    /// if (label != null) {
    ///     label.value = "Play";
    /// }
    /// ```
    static create(name: string, instanceName: string = ""): ViewModel;

    /// Whether the file has a view model called `name`.
    static exists(name: string): bool;

    /// The number property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let vm = context.viewModel();
    /// if (vm != null) {
    ///     let score = vm.getNumber("score");
    ///     if (score != null) {
    ///         console.log(score.value.toString());
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    getNumber(name: string): PropertyNumber?;

    /// The boolean property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getBoolean(name: string): PropertyBoolean?;

    /// The string property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getString(name: string): PropertyString?;

    /// The trigger property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getTrigger(name: string): PropertyTrigger?;

    /// The color property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getColor(name: string): PropertyColor?;

    /// The enum property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getEnum(name: string): PropertyEnum?;

    /// The list property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getList(name: string): PropertyList?;

    /// The nested view model property with the given name, or null when
    /// there is none.
    getViewModel(name: string): PropertyViewModel?;

    /// The image property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getImage(name: string): PropertyImage?;

    /// The font property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    getFont(name: string): PropertyFont?;

    /// The blob property with the given name, or null when there is none.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let data = vm.getBlob("levelData");
    /// if (data != null) {
    ///     let bytes = data.value;
    ///     if (bytes != null) {
    ///         console.log(bytes.byteLength.toString());
    ///     }
    /// }
    /// ```
    getBlob(name: string): PropertyBlob?;

    /// The artboard property with the given name, or null when there is
    /// none or the host has no network support.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let character = vm.getArtboard("character");
    /// if (character != null) {
    ///     character.value = null;
    /// }
    /// ```
    getArtboard(name: string): PropertyArtboard?;

    /// Creates a new instance of this view model, copied from its instance
    /// called `instanceName` when the file has one.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let copy = vm.instance();
    /// let age = copy.getNumber("age");
    /// if (age != null) {
    ///     age.value = 99;
    /// }
    /// ```
    instance(instanceName: string = ""): ViewModel;

    /// The view model's index in the list that holds it, counting from 0,
    /// or -1 when it has none.
    getIndex(): i32;

    /// Whether `other` is the same view model instance. Each lookup returns
    /// a new wrapper, so compare with this rather than `==`.
    equals(other: ViewModel?): bool;

    /// Releases the view model now instead of when it is collected. It reads
    /// nothing afterwards.
    release(): void;
}

/// A level of the data context hierarchy and its `ViewModel`. Get the one
/// bound to a script with `Context.dataContext`.
export class DataContext {
    /// The parent data context, or null at the top.
    ///
    /// ```as
    /// let dc = context.dataContext();
    /// if (dc != null) {
    ///     let parent = dc.parent();
    ///     let vm = dc.viewModel();
    /// }
    /// ```
    parent(): DataContext?;

    /// The view model bound to this context, or null when there is none.
    viewModel(): ViewModel?;
}
